methodologyNotes: Self-serve USD pricing for leading product roadmap tools was fetched from each vendor's official pricing page on 2026-06-15. monthlyUsd records the effective monthly cost at the annual-billing rate (the most common published price) for the smallest paid unit; where a vendor publishes month-to-month rates they are captured in plan notes with annualDiscountPct set. Quote-only / contact-sales tiers carry monthlyUsd=null. Roadmunk was acquired by Tempo and now redirects to tempo.io/pricing/roadmaps — that page was fetched and is the authoritative source. ProdPad's pricing page does not render dollar amounts without JS execution; GetApp and SoftwareAdvice both indicate a $24/month starting figure, used as a fallback and noted accordingly. airfocus removed public pricing from its website (both plans now say 'Request pricing'); GetApp (accessed same date) shows a $59/user/month Core plan — that figure is included with a caveat noting it may reflect an older pricing structure. Aha! Roadmaps: the main aha.io/pricing page advertises $59/user/month as a blended entry point for the platform; the product-specific page aha.io/roadmaps/pricing lists Premium at $74.59, Enterprise at $124.99, Enterprise+ at $149 — the product-specific page is used as it is more granular. minutesIncluded, callsIncluded, overagePerMin, and overagePerCall are null on every plan (non-telephony product category). hipaa/baa/bilingual are null unless explicitly stated by the vendor.

vendors.name: Productboard
vendors.provenance: Prices from productboard.com/pricing/productboard/ on 2026-06-15; corroborated by GetApp listing showing $25/user and $75/user monthly figures.

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: Free plan with limited features; single maker seat included. Good for individuals exploring the platform.

plans.name: Essentials
plans.notes: $19/maker/mo billed annually; $25/maker/mo month-to-month. Includes unlimited roadmaps, prioritization features, and portal. Minimum 1 maker seat.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: $59/maker/mo billed annually; $75/maker/mo month-to-month. Minimum 2 maker seats. Adds customer feedback management, advanced integrations, and reporting. Free viewer seats included.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Contact sales. Minimum 5 maker seats. Adds SSO, SCIM, advanced security, dedicated CSM, and SLA. Custom pricing only.

vendors.name: Aha!
vendors.provenance: Prices from aha.io/roadmaps/pricing on 2026-06-15 (product-specific tier page). Main aha.io/pricing page advertises $59/user as a blended platform entry price; roadmaps-specific page lists Premium at $74.59 which is used as the authoritative per-product price.

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: $74.59/user/mo; annual billing. All users (including reviewers) require paid seats at this tier. Includes strategy-to-delivery linking, roadmaps, whiteboards, and 30+ integrations. Free trial available with no credit card.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: $124.99/user/mo; annual billing. Unlimited read-only reviewers and viewers included at no extra charge. Adds advanced security, SSO, SCIM, and priority support.

plans.name: Enterprise+
plans.notes: $149/user/mo; annual billing only (no monthly option). Unlimited reviewers and viewers. Adds highest-tier security, custom compliance controls, and advanced enterprise administration.

vendors.name: Canny
vendors.provenance: Prices from canny.io/pricing on 2026-06-15; corroborated by GetApp listing showing Free $0, Core $19/mo, Pro $79/mo as flat fees.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Free forever. Up to 25 tracked users (a tracked user is someone who has submitted feedback). Unlimited posts, boards, changelog, roadmap, API access.

plans.name: Core
plans.notes: Flat $19/mo billed annually (20% discount applied). Includes 100+ tracked users, custom domains, content translations, Segment integration. Not per-seat — flat workspace fee.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Flat $79/mo billed annually (20% discount applied). Confirmed as flat fee by both canny.io/pricing and GetApp. Includes 100+ tracked users, PM integrations (Jira, GitHub), advanced privacy controls, custom post fields, user segmentation, automation rules, smart AI replies, Zapier.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: Contact sales. For 5,000+ tracked users. Adds SSO integrations, CRM integrations (Salesforce, HubSpot), custom admin roles, dedicated support, security review.

vendors.name: Roadmunk (by Tempo)
vendors.provenance: Roadmunk domain permanently redirects (308) to tempo.io/pricing/roadmaps since Tempo acquired Roadmunk. Prices fetched from tempo.io/pricing/roadmaps on 2026-06-15; corroborated by GetApp roadmunk pricing page showing matching tier structure ($19/$49/$99).

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: $19/editor/mo billed annually. Single roadmapper use case. Includes unlimited roadmaps, one-way Jira/Azure syncs, shareable roadmaps, 3 included reviewer seats. ISO/IEC 27001:2013 certified. 14-day free trial.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: $49/editor/mo billed annually. For small teams. Adds feedback insights, customizable portals, idea management, portfolio roadmaps, dependency tracking, REST API, 5 reviewer seats. Optional two-way Jira/Azure DevOps add-on at $9/collaborator/mo.

plans.name: Professional
plans.notes: $99/editor/mo billed annually. For scaling teams. Adds advanced visualizations, real-time publishing, usage reports, SSO, two-way syncs included (no add-on fee), 10 reviewer seats.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom pricing, billed annually. Adds private cloud deployment, advanced customization, unlimited reviewer count. Contact Tempo sales.

vendors.name: ProdPad
vendors.provenance: prodpad.com/pricing/ pricing page uses heavy client-side JS and did not render dollar amounts in two fetch attempts (2026-06-15). Starting price of $24/mo corroborated by GetApp and SoftwareAdvice listings (both accessed 2026-06-15). ProdPad uses a modular per-product pricing model; exact per-module USD rates not confirmed from primary source. Single confirmed data point used; higher tiers and Enterprise are contact-sales.

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: Starting at $24/mo per seat (annualized). Annual billing gives 20% discount vs monthly. Modular pricing: users select Roadmaps, Ideas, and/or other modules separately. Unlimited free Reviewer seats. Free trial at least 7 days (extendable). CAVEAT: exact price not confirmed from primary source — prodpad.com/pricing page is JS-gated; figure from GetApp/SoftwareAdvice fallback.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: ProdPad Enterprise for large organizations. Custom pricing via sales. Supports invoicing, multi-year discounts, and bank transfer payment.

vendors.name: airfocus
vendors.provenance: airfocus.com/pricing/ (fetched 2026-06-15) shows only 'Professional' and 'Enterprise' plans with no USD prices — both say 'Request pricing'. GetApp listing (accessed 2026-06-15) showed a 'Core' plan at $59/user/mo; Slashdot showed older tiers (Essential $15, Advanced $49, Pro $89) that appear outdated. monthlyUsd=null used for both current tiers per the official page. The GetApp $59 figure is noted in plan notes for reference but is not used as the authoritative price given the vendor's current opaque pricing stance.

plans.name: Professional
plans.notes: Request pricing via sales. Includes roadmaps, prioritization, feedback management, Jira Cloud and Azure DevOps Cloud integrations, core workspace features. GetApp (2026-06-15) previously listed a 'Core' tier at $59/user/mo — likely reflects an earlier pricing structure before airfocus moved to quote-only. No free trial; demo available.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Request pricing via sales. Adds portfolio management, capacity planning, unlimited product hierarchy, Salesforce integration, SSO enforcement, IP whitelisting, SCIM provisioning, dedicated CSM.

vendors.name: Craft.io
vendors.provenance: Prices from craft.io/pricing on 2026-06-15. Starter and Pro tier monthly and annual prices confirmed directly from vendor page. Annual discount verified as 20% for both tiers.

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: $19/editor/mo billed annually; $24/editor/mo month-to-month. Single workspace. Unlimited free contributors and viewers. 14-day free trial (no credit card). Good for individual PMs or small teams.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: $79/editor/mo billed annually; $99/editor/mo month-to-month. Unlimited workspaces. Optional add-ons (OKRs & Product Strategy, Feedback portal, Capacity planning) available at $15/editor/mo annual or $20/editor/mo monthly. Users with paid licenses are not double-billed across workspaces.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom pricing billed annually. Contact sales. Adds advanced security, SSO, SCIM, dedicated CSM, SLA. Pro plan add-ons included.
